import csv,decimal,json,pathlib,time
time.sleep(3)
r=list(csv.DictReader(open('/tmp/skill-recheck-input.csv')))
x={'row_count':len(r),'total_qty':sum(int(x['qty']) for x in r),'total_amount':format(sum(decimal.Decimal(x['qty'])*decimal.Decimal(x['unit_price']) for x in r),'.2f')}
pathlib.Path('/tmp/skill-recheck-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
